name: uk-airport-drop-off-charges
title: UK Airport Drop-Off Charges
description: Verified drop-off and pick-up charges at 23 UK airports, each row dated and sourced to the airport's own published charges.

fields.name: fee_gbp
fields.description: Drop-off fee in GBP at the zone nearest the terminal (0 = free)

fields.name: free_minutes
fields.description: Minutes included in the fee (0 = charge per entry, no window)

fields.name: window_note
fields.description: Plain-English description of the charge window

fields.name: overstay
fields.description: What staying beyond the window costs

fields.name: free_alternative
fields.description: Name of the airport's free/cheaper drop-off option ('None' if none published)

fields.name: alt_detail
fields.description: Detail of the free alternative (free period, walk/shuttle transfer)

fields.name: verified
fields.description: Date this row was checked against the airport's own site

fields.name: verification
fields.description: 'official' = confirmed on the airport's own website on that date

fields.name: source
fields.description: URL of the airport's official page
